# OASIS UBL 2.1 schemas (vendored)

Unmodified copies of the OASIS Universal Business Language 2.1 (OS, 4 November 2013) XSD files needed to validate an
`Order-2` document: `maindoc/UBL-Order-2.1.xsd` and the `common/` modules it imports, directly or indirectly.

- Source: https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/xsd/ (`maindoc/UBL-Order-2.1.xsd` and `common/*.xsd`, same relative paths)
- Fetched: 2026-11-15, each file downloaded as is.
- Copyright (c) OASIS Open 2013. All Rights Reserved. The files carry that notice in their headers and are distributed under
  the OASIS document licence stated at https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/UBL-2.1.html (see its Notices section).
  Used here only to validate the Peppol order export (`scripts/validate-peppol.ts`).
- The `UBL-xmldsig-core-schema-2.1.xsd` and `UBL-XAdESv*.xsd` files are the W3C XML-DSig and ETSI XAdES schemas as OASIS ships them in UBL 2.1.
